c6.refugee.speaker: Refugee
c6.refugee.text: The tower gate is open. We don't dare go up. You're the company's weakest?

c6.scroll_pile.speaker: Scroll
c6.scroll_pile.text: The weakest may reach the top. Crave strength, and the flame gets there first.

c6.tower_gate.speaker: Narration
c6.tower_gate.text: The tower gate is open. Black Flame breathes in the gap.

c0.shrine_stub.speaker: Shrine
c0.shrine_stub.text: The incense ash is cold. The people left first.

c0.leave_without_sword.speaker: System
c0.leave_without_sword.text: Empty-handed. Pick up that sword first.

c0.road_east.speaker: Narration
c0.road_east.text: The long road runs east. Cuiling is bigger than the map shows.

c1.flag_paw.speaker: System
c1.flag_paw.text: A crooked rabbit on the banner. The ears are wrong.

c1.flag_grey.speaker: System
c1.flag_grey.text: The grey banner hangs low. No one is waiting for a miracle.

c1.outer_ward.speaker: Narration
c1.outer_ward.text: The outer ward is wide. Only stone and wind left.

c1.sprout_after_leo.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_after_leo.text: I drew the rabbit on the banner! The ears came out crooked!

c1.sprout_after_leo.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_after_leo.text: I practise with a wooden sword every day. I'll guard the gate when I grow up.

c1.sprout_thanks.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_thanks.text: The wooden sword swings great! Is the lion big?

c1.sprout_wish.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_wish.text: Ding could make one. About twenty gold, I think.

c1.sprout_wish.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_wish.text: Not greedy. I want to practise where everyone can see.

c1.wild_need_forge.speaker: System
c1.wild_need_forge.text: The rusty sword's edge is curled. Find Ding first.

c1.burnt_field.speaker: Narration
c1.burnt_field.text: Burnt wheat field. Grip the sword.

c1.tower_empty.speaker: System
c1.tower_empty.text: The watchtower is empty. Only wind.

c1.wild_shrine.speaker: Shrine
c1.wild_shrine.text: "It isn't the gate you guard. It's the little light behind it."

c1.leo_gate_cleared.speaker: System
c1.leo_gate_cleared.text: The Sacred Lion is awake. The mist road southeast is open.

c1.leo_win.speaker: Leo
c1.leo_win.text: A knight isn't about size. It's about not retreating.

c1.leo_win.speaker: Leo
c1.leo_win.text: The gate opens for you. Go.

c1.leo_win.speaker: Leo
c1.leo_win.text: The flame wants your wanting. Don't feed it.

c1.leo_win.speaker: System
c1.leo_win.text: 80 gold, 4 stardust. Rage Thunder and Counterstrike are awake.

c2.arrive.speaker: Veilfog
c2.arrive.text: In the mist, true and false share a colour. Lend me your eyes.

c2.arrive.speaker: Veilfog
c2.arrive.text: Stay one night first. Night roads break in the heart before the feet.

c2.arrive.speaker: System
c2.arrive.text: The inn's campfire is waiting for you.

c2.lantern.speaker: Narration
c2.lantern.text: The lamp lights three paces. Beyond that, your eyes.

c2.well_fog.speaker: Narration
c2.well_fog.text: Mist in the well. Not water.

c2.laundry.speaker: Narration
c2.laundry.text: The clothes are wet. No one here.

c2.cat_shadow.speaker: Thought
c2.cat_shadow.text: A real cat, or the mist copying one?

c2.shrine.speaker: Mist Shrine
c2.shrine.text: "The true lasts an instant. The false has a thousand layers."

c2.shrine.speaker: Thought
c2.shrine.text: That instant is all I need.

c2.train_need_letter.speaker: System
c2.train_need_letter.text: Your mind is unsettled. Back to the inn first.

c2.train_tip.speaker: Veilfog
c2.train_tip.text: Shadows lie. The real body flashes.

c2.train_tip.speaker: System
c2.train_tip.text: Only the white flash can be hit. Tab switches targets.

c2.letter_reread.speaker: System
c2.letter_reread.text: The letter is still in the journal.

c2.letter_reread.speaker: Journal
c2.letter_reread.text: "I'm still here. Because you haven't come back." — Wheatear

c2.fog_need_letter.speaker: Veilfog
c2.fog_need_letter.text: You owe a letter. Back to the inn.

c2.fog_cleared.speaker: System
c2.fog_cleared.text: The Mirror Hall is quiet. Back to the village, or onward.

c2.fog_win.speaker: White Fog
c2.fog_win.text: Seen through. A mercenary can do that? Boring.

c2.fog_win.speaker: White Fog
c2.fog_win.text: The mist's gone. Report back or go on. Whatever.

c2.fog_win.speaker: System
c2.fog_win.text: 70 gold, 4 stardust. There's a bell on the mountain.

c3.soft_warn.speaker: System
c3.soft_warn.text: You can climb without seeing through the mist. Abo shows no mercy. Power {power}.

c3.soft_warn.speaker: System
c3.soft_warn.text: If it's not enough: forge, draw souls, train.

c3.arrive.speaker: Acha
c3.arrive.text: From the mist? The master is in the Trial Hall. He asks first.

c3.arrive.speaker: System
c3.arrive.text: Challenge Abo at the Trial Hall.

c3.gate_bell.speaker: Narration
c3.gate_bell.text: The bell rings. Why do you fight? Someone is waiting.

c3.dummy_done.speaker: System
c3.dummy_done.text: A new fist mark on the wooden dummy. Yours.

c3.scroll_wall.speaker: Fist Manual
c3.scroll_wall.text: "Breaking a stance takes diligence, not rage."

c3.scroll_wall.speaker: Fist Manual
c3.scroll_wall.text: "Full rage scatters the fist. Scattered, the stance breaks."

c3.stone_garden.speaker: Narration
c3.stone_garden.text: Pebbles laid out like a fist. One moved each day.

c3.abo_cleared.speaker: System
c3.abo_cleared.text: The Trial Hall is empty. Abo is drinking tea.

c4.arrive.speaker: Windear
c4.arrive.text: Slower than the wind. Good. Wait for the moment it stops.

c4.treehouse.speaker: Narration
c4.treehouse.text: A kite string tangled on the railing.

c4.stream.speaker: Narration
c4.stream.text: The stream is clear. No purple crack.

c4.owl_post.speaker: Thought
c4.owl_post.text: It watches the wind, not titles.

c4.watch_tower.speaker: Inscription
c4.watch_tower.text: Swiftshadow guards the wind. The wind guards travellers.

c4.watch_tower.speaker: Inscription
c4.watch_tower.text: When the wind goes wild, wait until it remembers it once stopped.

c4.watch_tower.speaker: Thought
c4.watch_tower.text: Waiting isn't weakness. See clearly, then shoot.

c4.falcon_cleared.speaker: System
c4.falcon_cleared.text: The nest is empty. Only wind and silver feathers.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: Swiftshadow
c4.falcon_win.text: You caught the wind. You were willing to stop.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: Swiftshadow
c4.falcon_win.text: The silver feather is yours. Remember someone was willing to stop.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: Windear
c4.falcon_win.text: Go. The coast is still roaring.

c5.arrive.speaker: Tideroar
c5.arrive.text: On the shore you compete by meeting it head-on. Stonefist forgot where to put his strength.

c5.dock.speaker: Narration
c5.dock.text: The docks are empty. Nets dry on the racks.

c5.dock.speaker: System
c5.dock.text: On the board: strength without direction is waves on an empty shore.

c5.boat_wreck.speaker: Narration
c5.boat_wreck.text: Half a sack of dry salt in the wreck. The people left first.

c5.net_rack.speaker: Narration
c5.net_rack.text: Nets crusted with salt. No one to take them in.

c5.runestone.speaker: Runestone
c5.runestone.text: "Strength is to guard, not to show."

c5.runestone.speaker: Thought
c5.runestone.text: A title won't break the shore. Meet it head-on.

c5.forge_tip_done.speaker: Tideroar
c5.forge_tip_done.text: The axe's will is in the edge, not the throat.

c5.cliff_path.speaker: System
c5.cliff_path.text: The ground lights up, then rocks fall. Press J on the light.

c5.boar_cleared.speaker: System
c5.boar_cleared.text: The cliff is quiet. Only the waves, like applause.

c5.boar_win.speaker: Stonefist
c5.boar_win.text: Ha! You're the one left standing.

c5.boar_win.speaker: Stonefist
c5.boar_win.text: Strength is for guarding the shore. Don't write 'hero' in your report.

c5.boar_win.speaker: Tideroar
c5.boar_win.text: To the tower. Your strength has an aim now.

c6.bell_not_rung.speaker: System
c6.bell_not_rung.text: The mountain bell hasn't rung. The dojo first.

c6.path_not_open.speaker: System
c6.path_not_open.text: The road isn't open yet. Finish the trial in front of you.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: Narration
c6.floor_shadow.text: The Hall of Shadows. Someone whispers from the walls.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: Phantom Voice
c6.floor_shadow.text: Get strong and save everyone? The flame laughs first.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: Thought
c6.floor_shadow.text: …No. That isn't quiet. It's going out.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: System
c6.floor_shadow.text: You crossed the Hall of Shadows without drawing your sword.

c6.demon_win.speaker: Predecessor
c6.demon_win.text: Next time… don't walk my road.

c6.demon_win.speaker: Predecessor
c6.demon_win.text: The sword is yours again. Or—give it to the next one as light as us.

post.rift_not_open.speaker: System
post.rift_not_open.text: The rift hasn't spilled yet. Finish the trial at the tower's top.
